name: agg_time_between_00
persona: a 23-year-old design student in Lisbon, enthusiastic, lots of exclamation marks
topic: a race and the recovery run after it

messages.text: Bought groceries today and it's raining so hard in Lisbon! Time for hot chocolate!
My friend Tomás ran the Alvalade race today and got a super cool medal! So jealous!
Signed up for the Lisbon Half Marathon today! It's happening on May 20th!
My mom's birthday is tomorrow, need to call her early! Design project is killing me though.
Ugh, the half marathon got postponed to June 3rd because of the storm warning today!
I actually ran the Lisbon Half Marathon today! My legs are total jelly but I finished!
Weather is gorgeous today, going to sketch in the park for my portfolio!
Did my very first recovery run today after the big half marathon! Felt surprisingly good!
Laundry day today, and my cat decided to sleep right on my freshly ironed shirts!
Ran the Cascais coastal 10k race today! Such stunning views!

questions.q: How many days passed between my half marathon and my first recovery run?
questions.why: The half marathon was on June 3rd and the recovery run was on June 25th, which is 22 days later.

questions.q: How many days after Tomás ran his race did I run my half marathon?
questions.why: Tomás ran a race, but I did not run mine on that date; my race happened later and the question asks about Tomás's event date relative to mine which cannot be answered for the user's run date.

questions.q: How many days between my half marathon and the Cascais 10k race?
questions.why: The half marathon was on June 3rd and the Cascais 10k was on July 15th, making it 42 days.

questions.q: How many days was my recovery run after the initial planned date of the half marathon?
questions.why: The initially planned half marathon date was May 20th, and the recovery run was on June 25th, exactly 36 days later.

name: agg_time_between_01
persona: a 33-year-old marketing consultant in Dubai, frequent flyer
topic: buying a car and its first service

messages.text: Hey, back from a grueling client workshop in Riyadh today. Need a weekend off soon.
My sister just bought a brand new Porsche Macan here in Dubai and she's obsessed with it. Makes me want an upgrade.
Spent the whole morning test driving SUVs. Finally decided and put down the deposit for a silver Lexus RX today.
Quick update on the car - the dealer called and delivery is rescheduled to next month, May 15th.
Picked up my new silver Lexus RX from the dealership this morning! Absolutely love the drive.
Hot summer starting in Dubai. Working from home today because the AC in my office building broke.
Heading to London for a two-week marketing consultancy stint. Flight leaves tonight.
Just got back to Dubai. Jetlagged but ready to tackle client emails.
Thinking about getting a second car, maybe a small electric runabout, but holding off for now.
Completed the first mandatory service for my Lexus RX at the dealership today. All good!
My colleague bought a Lexus too last week and was complaining about the waiting times for service.
Busy prepping for the year-end pitch decks. Need to drink more coffee.
Happy new year productivity! Redid my home office setup today.

questions.q: How many days passed between when I test drove and put down the deposit for my car and when I finally picked it up?
questions.why: The deposit was paid on April 12, 2025 and pickup was on May 15, 2025, which is 33 days later.

questions.q: How many months were there between picking up my Lexus RX and taking it in for its first service?
questions.why: Car was picked up on May 15, 2025 and the first service was on October 1, 2025, about 4.5 months later.

questions.q: How long after my sister bought her Porsche did I pick up my new Lexus?
questions.why: Sister bought her car on March 5, 2025 and user picked up the Lexus on May 15, 2025.

questions.q: How many days elapsed between my sister buying her car and my original planned delivery date before it got rescheduled?
questions.why: The original delivery date was only mentioned as 'next month, May 15th' without a specific exact calendar day stated in the text for the unrescheduled date.

name: agg_time_between_02
persona: a 43-year-old pharmacist in Dublin who volunteers on weekends
topic: a job offer and the start date

messages.text: It's freezing here in Dublin today, but at least the pharmacy inspection went well.
Spent my Saturday volunteering at the local food bank, quite busy.
My colleague Sarah just received a fantastic job offer from a hospital in Cork, really happy for her.
Got a preliminary job offer for a senior pharmacist role at St. James's, need to look over the terms.
We originally agreed my start date at St. James's would be June 1st, but I need more time.
Finished sorting out the paperwork. My official start date for the new pharmacist job is June 15th, 2025.
Today was my very first day at the new job, feeling pretty exhausted.
All set for the weekend volunteering shift at the animal shelter.
Another pharmacy down the street offered me a consultancy gig today, but I'm going to pass.
Weather in Dublin is finally turning nice, hope it lasts through the weekend.
Just got an offer to lecture part-time at the university starting next month.

questions.q: How many days passed between when I got my preliminary job offer and when I finalized my start date?
questions.why: The preliminary offer was on May 12, 2025, and the final start date was set on May 28, 2025, which is 16 days later.

questions.q: How many days were there between when Sarah received her job offer and when I got my preliminary offer?
questions.why: Sarah's offer was on April 5, 2025, and my preliminary offer was on May 12, 2025, exactly 37 days later.

questions.q: How many days elapsed from when I finalized my start date to my actual first day on the job?
questions.why: The start date was finalized on May 28, 2025, and the first day of work was June 15, 2025, making 18 days.

questions.q: How many weeks after my initial June 1st planned start date did I actually begin the new job?
questions.why: The June 1st date was only mentioned as an originally discussed date that was rescheduled, so the actual start date wasn't based on a fixed interval from that unexecuted plan.
